title: Mao Zedong dies
summary: Mao Zedong, leader of the People's Republic of China since 1949, died in Beijing.
reason: Mao was 82 and had suffered from ill health.
significance: His death led to the fall of the Gang of Four and opened the way to Deng Xiaoping's reforms.
